systems.owner: Direcção-Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação (DGRNI); supervision by the Unidade de Coordenação da Reforma do Estado
systems.tiers: Requests received at the conservatórias do registo civil, at other public services such as the Casa do Cidadão by protocol, by a mobile reception service for remote communities, and at embassies and consular posts; rollout gradual over a multi-year cycle

systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)
systems.country_label: SNIAC; base de dados do SNIAC civil
systems.tiers: Central database that confirms or generates the civil identification number (NIC) when a card request is processed; in progressive implementation since 2007

note: The decree-law creates the national identity card and governs its issue; it concerns identity enrolment only, taking names and filiation from the birth entry, and states nothing about how a civil registration office records a birth or death.
